Binary.description: Bytes of a file, as stored.

cursor.description: Pass back as `cursor` to get what changed since.

ConnectionConfig.description: Backend configuration. Serialised to JSON and encrypted at rest.

oneOf.description:
A folder on the server. `path` is relative to the server's
`STRATA_LOCAL_BASE`, so users cannot reach arbitrary server paths.

left_on_storage.description:
Trashed items from it that couldn't be removed from its storage (it
couldn't be reached); they stay there (a local folder keeps them in
`.strata-trash`).

id.description: When editing, blank secrets are taken from this connection.

reason.description: Why it failed, in plain words.

health.description: ok | degraded | offline | unknown (not probed yet)

health_error.description:
The backend's own (sanitized) message: admins only, since it can
name hosts and paths.

health_reason.description: Why the last probe failed, in plain words anyone may see.

permanent.description: Skip the trash and delete for good.

trashed.description: How many of them went to the trash.

EmptyBody.description: An answer with nothing to say.

mount_id.description: Set when this entry is a mount point.

offline.description: A mount point whose storage is offline (it stays in the listing).

ErrorBody.description: Every error: a message for people (never internal details).

etag.description: On 412: the file's current version, if it exists.

trash.description: Deletes here go to the trash (else they are permanent).

token.description:
A session token for `Authorization: Bearer` (the response also sets
the session cookie).

journal_from.description: Journal entries of the volume up to this seq predate the mount.

path.description: Folder in the owner's tree ('' = root).

MountCreatedBody.description: A new mount, and other mounts showing an overlapping folder.

failed.description:
Items that could not be removed now (their storage is offline);
they stay in the trash.

resync.description: The cursor is too old: list again from scratch.

ShareInfoBody.description:
A public share: locked (`needs_password`), a folder (with `entries`) or
a file (with `size` and `mtime`).

more.description: More items are older than the last one (ask with `before`).

retention_days.description: Days an item stays before it is purged (0: the trash is off).

key.description: Pass as `k` to the other public routes (null: no password needed).

missing.description: Indexes of the chunks the server still needs.

session.description: The session cookie. Requests other than GET/HEAD must also send an `X-Strata` header (any value): browsers can't add it cross-site.
session.name: strata_session

info.description: The HTTP API of Strata, a self-hosted file cloud.
